text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We were discussing our training strategy 
going forward, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. Incorporating straight-line 
enhancement drills sounds perfectly fine."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Please let me take the rest back to 
review. That concludes today's agenda. If 
you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's rare for Dream Journey to postpone 
solving a problem. Maybe it's just my 
imagination, but she doesn't look quite 
well either...
choice_data_list:
...Hey, um. Are you not feeling well, by 
any chance?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, there's no problem at all. Thank you 
for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no opening in Dream Journey's 
smile... Unable to read her true 
intentions, I had no choice but to step 
aside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey was plagued by headaches for 
a while...
